category_edits.rationale: Learn a positive coordinate gain shared by tied history and candidate embeddings in each category's single GRU4Rec model. Zero-initialized log gains preserve the initial unit-normalized representation while allowing coordinate importance to adapt. Keep dimensions, GRU topology, scoring, loss and optimizer fixed.

response.change_summary: Add jointly learned positive coordinate gains before tied item embedding normalization across all four datasets. Gains are saved in each model's checkpoint; the embedded predictor imports the updated class and validates matching metadata.
